text: This was a magical experience. Cool, refreshing and traquil. A beautiful way to see the city. Our guide was brilliant and it was my favourite 2 hours in Sevilla. Thank you!
author: S9600HPcrumble

title: Paddle boarding in Seville
text:
What a fabulous time we had. 
We had great guides who took us on a tour of some of the historic buildings we could see from the river, made very special by the sunsetting as a back drop.
Well worth the experience, the river gave us a very special and different view of Seville! 
Our guides were knowledgeable and fun- paying special attention to keeping us safe at all times.
author: K6545KXandyb

title: Great experience seeing a...
text: Great experience seeing a different side of Seville from the water. The instructors were very knowledgeable with stories about Seville.
author: Jessica_O

title: Excellent trip
text: Very professional company. Good changing facilities before/after the trip and they provide flipflops to wear to get to the waters edge. Good safety briefing before going on the water. Equipment was very good, including the SUP, paddle and buoyancy aid. The trip was very relaxed and we enjoyed it immensely. Nice touch was the guide would take photos and these were provided free of charge the following day on WhatsApp. A shout out to our guide, Rodrigo. Great company and some good stories about the sights on the river. We are very experienced on SUPs and I would thoroughly recommend this company
author: Angela W

title: Very good
text: Staff were really helpful and kind. It was very interesting and gave a new perspective on the city. Very highly recommended.

title: Great family experience
text: Great experience with helpful guides catering to all experience levels and all the family.  Thank you so much for making it such great fun.

title: Seville version paddle
text: I wanted to thank you for this great paddleboarding experience in Seville. Welcoming, guiding, setting and organization were excellent. It was a real pleasure to discover the city from the water, in ideal conditions. Many thanks also for the photos. I will definitely recommend.
